title: Digi Power X Inc. 8-K Filing — 2026-04-09
summary: Digi Power X Inc., a British Columbia corporation listed on Nasdaq (ticker: DGXX), entered into an amended at-the-market sales agreement with A.G.P. / Alliance Global Partners on April 9, 2026, allowing the company to issue and sell subordinate voting shares with an aggregate offering price of up to $75 million. This is a standard corporate equity distribution filing with no relevance to market structure or macro catalysts.
key_points: Digi Power X Inc. entered into an amended ATM agreement with A.G.P. / Alliance Global Partners on April 9, 2026.
The company may issue and sell subordinate voting shares (ticker: DGXX) with an aggregate offering price of up to US$75 million.
Sales will be made through ordinary broker transactions on Nasdaq Capital Market at market prices.
Agent commission rate is up to 3.0% of aggregate gross proceeds.
The company filed a prospectus supplement on Form S-3 with the SEC on April 9, 2026.
The company has no obligation to sell any shares and may suspend or terminate the agreement at any time.
